composition_subtypes.role: Sort creatures by conversion gain (hp - dmg) descending.
Select top b creatures with positive gain for conversion.

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort creatures by gain, greedily pick top b conversions, then for each creature try doubling it and adjust conversion set by dropping smallest gain if needed.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables efficient greedy selection; a second greedy step tests each creature as the double-spell target, using a swap with the smallest selected conversion to optimize total damage.
